s:
天空：每个行星在太阳（或月球）的每日瞬间进行采样，绘制其当时在天空的位置——与八字形进行比较。
恒星：每个行星相对于星场的轨迹，随着天空实时旋转——记录了实向逆行循环复合图。火星、木星和土星在对冲时绘制其向后循环；水星和金星在接近太阳时描绘其轨迹。
src:
Sky: each planet sampled at the sun's (or moon's) daily instant, drawn where it stood in the sky then — compares against the figure-eight.
Stars: each planet's track against the star field, turned with the sky in real time — the frame real retrograde-loop composites are registered in. Mars, Jupiter and Saturn draw their backward loops around opposition; Mercury and Venus trace theirs near the sun.

s: 每个年圆样本都在正午，因此恒星虽然出现但被白昼淹没。这会调暗天穹（而非地面照明），让恒星、银河系、行星和黄道可见，这样您就可以观察到一年内星空在太阳后旋转的过程。0 = 关闭。
src: Every analemma sample is at noon, so the stars are up but drowned in daylight. This dims the sky dome (not the lighting on the ground) and lets the stars, Milky Way, planets and zodiac through, so you can watch the star field turn once a year behind the sun. 0 = off.

s: 在与太阳（或月球）路径相同的瞬间追踪水星、金星、火星、木星和土星。水星和金星围绕太阳的八字形循环；外行星每个交点周期扫过一次天空。颜色遵循“设置”→“恒星与行星”中的行星颜色；如果那里关闭了某个行星，则不会有路径。
src: Trace Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn at the same instants as the sun (or moon) path. Mercury and Venus loop around the sun's figure-eight; the outer planets sweep the sky once per synodic period. Colours follow the planet colours in Settings → Stars & Planets; a planet switched off there gets no path.

s: 高度值可上下移动天空的地平线（高于水平线的度数）— 对无人机视角特别有用，因为地形边缘可能会低于水平线。柔和度决定了天空需要下降多远才能达到地平线颜色。薄雾带是这种颜色的光晕，向上淡入天空；它用于平坦地带将朦胧的远地地面与天空融合。两个天空颜色分别是晴朗白天的渐变（黄昏和夜晚会覆盖它们）。
src: Height moves the sky's horizon line up or down (degrees above level) — useful from a drone, where the terrain's edge sits below level. Softness is how far below the line the sky takes to reach the horizon colour. The haze band is a glow of that colour fading up into the sky; it is what blends hazy distant ground into the sky on flat land. The two sky colours are the clear daytime gradient (twilight and night paint over them).

s: 霾是远距离的雾，它将远处的地面淡化到天空。密度 × 决定了它随距离变浓的快慢（越低 = 越清晰的沙漠空气）；雾量在上面增加更多，也设置了体积雾的厚度（灯光）。“采天空色”决定了远地地面吸收天空自身颜色的多少，而不是霾的颜色。黄昏冷度将黄昏霾从暖琥珀色（0）推向蓝灰色（1）。日落时分消散在日落前几个小时稀释霾，使远处的山脊保持黑暗。
src: The haze is the distance fog that fades far ground toward the sky. Density × scales how quickly it thickens with distance (lower = clearer desert air); Fog amount adds more on top and also sets the thickness of volumetric fog (Lighting). "Takes sky colour" is how much distant ground picks up the sky's own colour instead of the haze colour. Dusk coolness pushes twilight haze from warm amber (0) to blue-grey (1). Late-day clearing thins the haze in the hours before sunset so distant ridges stay dark.

s: 将地平线和大气霾中的所有控制项恢复到默认值。

s: 阳光遵循真实大气：直到光盘越过地平线之前没有，然后是深橙色的百分比，到 10° 时减半，到 30° 时变为白色。低日照暖度是地平线附近直射光变红的程度（0 = 白色）。
src: Sunlight follows the real atmosphere: none until the disc clears the horizon, then a few percent of noon in deep orange, half strength by 10°, white by 30°. Low-sun warmth is the reddening of the direct light near the horizon (0 = white).

s: 戏剧性调节地平线火带、太阳光环和地平线附近的辉光，以及与太阳对立的粉色金星带（1.0 = 自然，0 = 平坦）。时长决定了日落后天空和地面淡化的速度（1 = 自然，为屏幕压缩）。
src: Drama scales the horizon fire band, the sun's aureole and glow near the horizon, and the pink Belt of Venus opposite the sun (1.0 = natural, 0 = flat). Length stretches how slowly the sky and ground fade after sunset (1 = natural, compressed for the screen).

s: 深空接近纯黑渐变，加上三个光源：空光（深空低处的微弱绿带）、光污染穹顶和月光（月亮 → 月夜天空）。无月夜所有为零 = 博特尔1级荒野天空。明亮的天空会冲淡微弱的星光（恒星与行星 → 天空光冲淡）。
src: The dark sky is a near-black gradient plus three light sources: airglow (the faint green band real dark skies show low down), a light-pollution dome, and moonlight (Moon → Moonlit sky). All zero on a moonless night = a Bortle-1 wilderness sky. Bright skies wash out faint stars (Stars & Planets → Sky-glow washout).

s: 预设缩放阴影贴图大小、柔和阴影过滤、TAA和植被层级（细节环大小、叶子密度、树木预算）。超级模式增加树木阴影和更大的细节环。
src: Presets scale shadow-map size, soft-shadow filtering, TAA, and the vegetation tier (detail-ring size, leaf density, tree budgets). Ultra adds tree shadows and bigger detail rings.

s: 通过获取更广区域更高缩放级别的航空瓦片来锐化近距离（步行）地形。更高层级会占用更多VRAM和更长的首次下载时间（之后会缓存）；仅适用于生成的地点地图。雕塑速度不受影响。
src: Sharpens close-up (walking) terrain by fetching higher-zoom aerial tiles over a wider area. Higher tiers use more VRAM and a longer first download (then cached); only applies to generated location maps. Sculpting speed is unaffected.

s: 仅此世界。您站点附近的近景影像可能来自比地图其余部分老了多年的更清晰照片，因此变化的事物（海岸线、新建筑）可能会在边缘跳跃。最新照片使用与周围地图相同的照片：所有地方日期一致，近处略柔和。
src: This world only. The close-up imagery round your site can come from a sharper photo that is sometimes years older than the rest of the map, so things that change (a shoreline, new buildings) can jump at its edge. Newest uses the same photo as the map round it: one date everywhere, a little softer up close.

s: 太阳、月亮、环境光、辉光、雾气、色调映射和夜空在世界内部进行调整（时间轴上的设置 ⚙ → 光照和环境），您可以在其中看到它们。
src: Sun, moon, ambient, glow, fog, tonemapping and the night sky are tuned inside a world (Settings ⚙ on the timeline → Lighting and Environment), where you can see them.

s: 用于室内、遮阳结构和营地的多次反弹光全局照明。已根据具有更广阔室外级联和在测绘无人机高度平滑衰减的日光模型进行校准。
src: Bounced-light global illumination for interiors, shade structures and camps. Calibrated to DaylightModel with wider outdoor cascades and a smooth fade at survey-drone altitudes.

s: 将 SDFGI 的间接光与校准的室外基线进行缩放（1.0 与周围的天空环境光匹配；提高以获得更强的室内/墙面反弹）。
src: Scales SDFGI indirect light relative to the calibrated outdoor baseline (1.0 matches the surrounding sky ambient; raise for stronger indoor/wall bounce).

s: 关闭时，只有 3D 结构、车辆和道具会接收 SDFGI，而地形使用平滑的天空环境光（阳光仍会从地面反弹到墙壁上）。消除了开阔地面上的任何级联接缝，即使提高了 SDFGI 强度 ×。
src: When off, only 3D structures, vehicles and props receive SDFGI while terrain uses smooth sky ambient (sunlight still bounces off the ground onto walls). Eliminates any cascade seam on open ground even if SDFGI strength × is boosted.

s: 精细调整所有参数化结构的光粗糙度、法线、颗粒和清漆，或上传自定义 PBR 纹理。
src: Fine-tune roughness, normals, grain and clearcoat across all parametric structures, or upload custom PBR textures.

s: 其厚度遵循 环境 → 大气雾霾 → 雾量。
src: How thick it is follows Environment → Atmospheric haze → Fog amount.

s: 替代 TAA 的平滑效果 — 边缘更锐利，风吹植被无鬼影，但 GPU 消耗更高。
src: Alternative to TAA's smoothing — sharper edges, no ghosting on wind-animated foliage, more GPU cost.

s: 耶稣光（体积雾中的光束）
src: God rays (light shafts via volumetric fog)

s: 耶稣光启用薄体积雾，使太阳投射出日出/日落时最强的丁达尔光束。会增加一些 GPU 消耗。
src: God rays enable a thin volumetric fog so the sun casts crepuscular shafts, strongest at sunrise/sunset. Adds some GPU cost.

s: 世界绘制的方式。风格只改变画面：模拟使用的光照（太阳能输出、植物、人物）在所有风格中都是相同的。
src: How the world is drawn. A style changes only the picture: the light the simulation uses (solar output, plants, people) is the same in every style.

s: 0 为写实外观；1 为设计风格。
src: 0 is the realistic look; 1 is the style as designed.

s: 物体周围的深色线条和褶皱。1 为风格自身的。
src: Dark lines round near things and their creases. 1 is the style's own.

s: 将纹理细节平铺成涂抹的色块（叶子变成画笔块）。1 为风格自身的。
src: Flattens texture detail into painted patches (leaves into brush blobs). 1 is the style's own.

s: 光线呈几个平坦的带状而非平滑的渐变。1 为风格自身的。
src: Light falls into a few flat bands instead of a smooth gradient. 1 is the style's own.

s: 每个恒星盘体会因一个纹素而侵蚀/膨胀。颜色来自每个盘体的边缘（导出时将核心裁剪为白色）。过曝度决定了多少月光和光污染会遮盖微弱的恒星。
src: Point size erodes/dilates every star disc by a texel. Colour comes from each disc's fringe (the export clips cores to white). Washout is how much moonlight and light pollution hide the faint stars.

s: 锁定相机指向天空（天文静帧）
天空中极光（真实空间天气）
src: Aurora in the sky (real space weather)

s: 根据模拟时钟的实时北极光和南极光，参考真实Kp指数（过去一周的NOAA SWPC和3天预报，GFZ Potsdam可追溯至1932年）以及NOAA的OVATION实时预报。仅在夜间、云层后可见；其到达极点的距离遵循Kp指数。
src: The northern and southern lights at the sim clock's time, from the real Kp index (NOAA SWPC for the last week and the 3-day forecast, GFZ Potsdam back to 1932) and NOAA's OVATION nowcast near the present. Seen only after dark, behind the clouds; how far from the poles it reaches follows the Kp.

s: 配准由tools/starmap_prepare.py测量（图像旁边的sidecar .json）。HOME切换参考星标记。
src: Registration is measured by tools/starmap_prepare.py (sidecar .json next to the image). HOME toggles reference-star markers.

s: 带星空：夜间，以及当“日间星空”开启时的天机模式。始终：在白天的天空上也显示。
src: With the stars: at night, and in analemma mode when 'Stars through daylight' is on. Always: over the daytime sky too.

s: 黄道带也穿过蛇工座（IAU星座边界，1930年）：太阳每年在此停留约18天，位于天蝎座和射手座之间。
src: The ecliptic also crosses Ophiuchus (IAU constellation boundaries, 1930): the sun spends about 18 days of each year there, between Scorpius and Sagittarius.

s: 来自Stellarium“现代”天空文化（CC BY-SA 4.0）的图样，与星图具有相同的配准。
src: Figures from Stellarium's 'modern' sky culture (CC BY-SA 4.0), in the same registration as the star map.

s: 高亮显示时（看向一个星球）
将模拟锁定到实时 Home Assistant 数据，以 1× 速度与挂钟同步。关闭以拖动和加速时间。
src: Locks simulation to wall clock at 1× speed for live Home Assistant data. Turn off to scrub and speed up time.

s: 实时模式（同步系统时钟）
已更改。点击可恢复到打开设置时的值
src: Changed. Click to put back the value it had when you opened Settings

s: 在低于原生分辨率下渲染 3D 世界并进行放大——对于受 GPU 限制（低帧率）的场景最大的调节器。UI 保持清晰。100% = 原生。
src: Renders the 3D world below native resolution and upscales it — the biggest lever for GPU-limited (low-FPS) scenes. UI stays crisp. 100% = native.

s: 小道具在超出绘制距离后会淡出以节省 GPU；大型地标（StarShade、穹顶、货架）保持可见。关闭道具阴影有助于处理拥有数千个道具的场地。F3 打开实时帧成本覆盖层。
src: Small props fade out past the draw distance to save GPU; large landmarks (StarShade, domes, racks) stay visible. Turning off prop shadows helps on sites with thousands of props. F3 opens the live frame-cost overlay.

s: 帧时间超过 22 ms，且 MSAA 高于此图形预设。在茂密森林中 8× 大约是 12 ms。预设是更经济的设置。
src: Frame time is over 22 ms and MSAA is above this graphics preset. 8× was about 12 ms on a dense forest. Preset's is the cheaper setting.

s: 点击一个键进行更改，然后按下新键（或鼠标侧键；Esc 取消）。按键按位置记忆，因此在任何键盘布局上都会保持原位。↺ 将按键恢复到默认。F1 帮助、屏幕提示和导览将显示您选择的内容。
src: Click a key to change it, then press the new key (or a mouse side button; Esc cancels). Keys are remembered by position, so they stay put on any keyboard layout. ↺ puts a key back to the default. The F1 help, the on-screen prompts and the tour show whatever you choose.

s: 所有按键均恢复到默认值。
src: Every key is back to its default.

s: F5 在游戏中在两者间切换。第三人称是跟随摄像机：鼠标围绕它旋转，您朝它面向方向行走，身体会跟随转动；在载具上则在后方追随。
src: F5 switches between them in play. Third person is a follow camera: the mouse orbits it, you walk the way it faces and your body turns to follow; on a vehicle it chases behind.

s: 步行时的水平视场角，两种视图均适用。越广 = 周边视野越广（且透视畸变更明显）。无人机 FOV 在“无人机”选项卡下。
src: Horizontal field of view on foot, in both views. Wider = more peripheral view (and more lens distortion). Drone FOV is under the Drone tab.

s: 驾驶时将摄像机甩到车辆后方
src: Swing the camera back behind a vehicle while driving

s: 默认模型是 NPC 的精细版骨架。如需使用其他角色，请将 .glb、.gltf 或 .fbx 文件拖放到角色文件夹中并按下重新扫描。其自带的动作片段用于命名为 idle / walk / run 的动作；没有这些片段的 Mixamo 骨架角色将借用 Remy 的 idle、walk 和 jog（需要玩家角色包）。当安装了该包后，Remy 会出现在列表中。
src: The default body is a detailed version of the NPCs' stick figure. To play as another character, drop a .glb, .gltf or .fbx into the characters folder and press Rescan. Its own clips are used when they are named idle / walk / run; a Mixamo-rigged character without them borrows Remy's idle, walk and jog (needs the Player Character pack). Remy appears in the list when that pack is installed.

s: 人群细节（外观 vs 性能）
高速下更轻（300× 以上减少全人物和完全模拟）
src: Lighter at high speed (fewer full figures and full simulation above 300×)

s: 在 300× 及以上倍率下，全人物会模糊：请缩小两个预算（在 300× 时约为 60%，在 1000× 时约为 30%）以保持帧率。
src: At 300× and faster a full figure is a blur: shrink both budgets (to about 60 % at 300×, 30 % at 1000×) to keep the frame rate up.

s: 当前：此地图上未模拟人群。
src: Now: no people simulated on this map.

s: 调高一个数值，观察此处的帧率（或按 F3）。完全模拟和全人物消耗 CPU；人群人物及其覆盖范围消耗 GPU。0 / 最左侧 = 自动。
src: Turn a number up and watch the frame rate here (or F3). The full simulation and the full figures cost CPU; the crowd figures and their reach cost GPU. 0 / far left = Auto.

s: 关闭：每人都处于冻结和隐藏状态，无模拟或渲染成本。栖息地按其设定的固定速率计费人口数，因此图表中的水/食物/废物数据仍然有意义。重新开启后，社区将从上次中断的地方恢复（长时间间隔会按常规方式补齐）。节日模式会重新开启它。
src: Off: every person is frozen and hidden, with no simulation or rendering cost. Habitats bill their authored headcount at the classic constant rate, so the graph's water/food/waste numbers still mean something. Switch back on and the community resumes where it was left (a long gap is caught up the usual way). Festival mode switches it back on.

s: 关闭以进行现场分析——无 NPC 逻辑、人物、人群、芯片或警报。人员处于暂停状态，而非删除。
src: Turn off for site analysis — no NPC logic, figures, crowd, chips or alarms. The people are paused, not deleted.

s: 使用工具为骨架人物摆姿势和设置关键帧——锯木、钻孔、固定、携带——并保存建筑工人的动作片段。
src: Pose and keyframe the stick figure with a tool in its hands — sawing, drilling, fastening, carrying — and save the clips the build crews play.

s: 简化版绘制带有肘部和膝盖的关节骨架。行为相同——仅外观改变。当人员重新进入视野时生效。
src: Simplified draws articulated stick figures with elbows and knees. Behaviour is identical — only the look changes. Takes effect as people come back into view.

s: 简化风格：附近骨架人物偶尔会爆发成真实的动作捕捉片段（太棒了，欢呼、跳舞、故事、伸展……）后再平稳恢复。0 = 从不（仅程序化），中间 = 按设计，右 = 频率翻倍。片段存储在 Imported Models/NPC/mocap/<moment>/（参见 docs/ASSETS.md）；没有片段的时刻保持程序化。
src: Simplified style: how often a nearby stick figure breaks into a real motion-captured clip (FUCK YES, a cheer, a dance break, a story, a stretch…) before easing back. 0 = never (procedural only), middle = as designed, right = twice as often. Clips live in Imported Models/NPC/mocap/<moment>/ (see docs/ASSETS.md); a moment with none stays procedural.

s: 未安装类人角色包（参见 docs/ASSETS.md）——无论如何都使用简化版。
src: The humanoid character pack is not installed (see docs/ASSETS.md) — simplified is in use regardless.

s: 在表演舞台附近跳舞的人会随着节拍移动，在低音构建时举起双手并在低音落下时跳跃；DJ 在预热阶段会举起一只手臂。舞台自身的曲目（其音乐）会实时分析；没有曲目的演出会生成一个典型节拍的虚拟曲目。LED 灯在灯光工作室（J）有自己的“声音响应”开关。
src: People dancing near a playing stage move on its beat, put their hands up as a drop builds and jump when it lands; the DJ holds an arm up through the run-up. A stage's own track (its Music) is analysed live; a set with no track gets a made-up one at a typical tempo. LED lights have their own "Sound reactive" switch in the Light Studio (J).

s: 默认情况下，每个人都有独特的柔和轮廓。关闭后，所有人渲染为纯黑色——无个体颜色。
src: Each person gets a distinct pastel outline by default. Turn off to render everyone in plain black — no individual colors.

s: 每个头部上方的任务标签（以及下方是否启用的情绪条）。“始终”显示距离约 30 m 内的人；“关闭”保持干净的轮廓（瞄准时仍显示姓名）。
src: The task tag (and, if enabled below, the morale bar) above each head. 'Always' shows them for people within ~30 m; 'Off' keeps clean silhouettes (aiming still names people).

s: 每个太棒了！！！（发生地点）上的信标
src: Beacon over each FUCK YES!!! (where it happened)

s: 乐趣值（人群的整体氛围，一个指针表）
src: Fun Meter (the crowd's overall vibe, a needle gauge)

s: 一个人在太棒了！！！时能提高周围人群几率的强度。0 = 无传播（每次高峰都是独立的火花），1 = 按设计，4 = 野火。
src: How strongly one person at FUCK YES!!! raises the odds of the people round them. 0 = no spread (every peak is its own spark), 1 = as designed, 4 = wildfire.

s: 每个场地在演出期间播放的曲目音量（在场地的 Ctrl-焦点行 → 音乐中设置场地的曲目）。0 = 关闭。
src: Volume of the tracks venues play during their sets (set a venue's track in its Ctrl-focus row → Music). 0 = off.

s: 第一人称音景：风与天气风速、雨与降雨量、最近溪流的潺潺声、森林中的鸟鸣。当时钟暂停且远离第一人称时保持静音。将您自己的 wind / rain / stream / birds .mp3、.ogg 或 .wav 放入 user://ambient/ 以替换内置声音。0 = 关闭。
src: The first-person sound bed: wind with the weather's wind speed, rain with the rain rate, the nearest stream's rush, birdsong by daylight in the forest. Silent while the clock is paused and away from first person. Drop your own wind / rain / stream / birds .mp3, .ogg or .wav into user://ambient/ to replace the built-in sounds. 0 = off.

s: 人们会根据过得好不好而发光；一个需求得到满足、充满活力的群体会朝着太棒了！！！积聚“能量”——一种在身体上生长的、加速的绿色微光，附近有高峰时更快（头上的仪表会显示，有人为其供能时有 ↑）——然后转变为绿色脉冲光芒和桑巴舞。每个人都会获得一次巅峰体验。每个人的状态（太糟了！！！……可算！）会显示在他们头上；默认情况下，这些条是关闭的。
src: People glow with how good a time they are having; a crowd that is vibing with its needs met builds a CHARGE toward FUCK YES!!! — a green shimmer that grows and quickens on the body, faster with peakers nearby (the meter over their head shows it, with ↑ while someone is feeding it) — then tips into a green, pulsing glow and the samba. Every one scores a Peak Experience. Each person's state (FUCK THIS!!! … Fuck It!) shows over their head; the bars are off by default.

s: 远处的点状人群（光流到达人物后）
src: Distant crowd as dots (the light crowd past the figure reach)

s: 节日人群的远景，以点状形式绘制至 3 km。关闭时：无点状显示——光流仅绘制您附近的个体，并向人群范围边缘消散。您附近的任何人都不会突然出现或消失。
src: The far field of the festival crowd, drawn as dots out to 3 km. Off: no dots — the light crowd is drawn only as figures near you and dissolves out toward the edge of the Crowd figure reach. Nobody near you ever pops in or out either way.

s: 在节日规模下，您所在的营地保留完整人物；其他营地则以近处人物和远方点状形式显示。‘仅限本营’仅绘制您所在的营地；‘无人群’隐藏所有人（模拟和场地规划继续运行）。
src: At festival scale the camp you are in keeps full bodies; every other camp is a light crowd drawn as figures up close and dots far away. 'Home camp only' draws just your camp; 'Nobody' hides everyone (the simulation and the Site Plan keep running).

s: 护栏关闭，用于尝试新功能。‘理想供应’满足所有需求，如同基础设施完美无缺，并报告其必须提供的量（最优需求）；其他选项则停止队列、离开和警报信息流。
src: Guardrails off, for trying things out. 'Ideal supply' meets every need as if the infrastructure were perfect and reports what it would have to deliver (the optimal demand); the others stop queues, departures and the alarm feed.

s: 理想供应——满足所有需求，短缺计为进口
src: Ideal supply — every need met, shortfalls counted as imports

s: 无人员离开、消亡或使定居点崩溃
src: Nobody leaves, perishes or collapses the colony

s: 静音定居点信息流、警报和提示
src: Mute the settlement feed, alarms and toasts

s: 一个从放置地块开始的营地初始拥有多少天的水、食物和柴火（也是检查员的默认值）
src: How many days of water, food and firewood a camp stamped from a placement lot starts with (also the inspector's default)

s: 所有节日营地的总人数，按每个营地的绘制大小划分。0 = 每个营地的独立人数（来自其区域或您输入的数字）。实时生效；人员名单会原地增减。
src: Total people across every festival camp, split by each camp's painted size. 0 = each camp's own headcount (from its area, or the number you typed). Applies live; rosters grow and shrink in place.

s: 打开最近的活动栖息地的人员名单、日程表和杂务板。也可从该栖息地的检查员面板的图表中查看。
src: Opens the roster, schedules, and chore board for the nearest active habitat. Also available from that habitat's inspector panel in the graph.

s: 输入以查找设置；回车键打开包含该设置的第一个页面。
src: Type to find a setting; Enter opens the first page that has it.
Warn me when a hazard begins

s: 危险警报基于该地点的真实数据触发——空气质量读数、天气档案和国家气象局警报历史。戏剧性仅衡量危险看起来有多严重；它绝不会改变太阳能输出或健康背后的物理原理。关闭危险警报会将其从模拟中完全移除。
src: Hazards are triggered from real data for this site — air-quality readings, the weather archive, and National Weather Service alert history. Drama scales only how severe a hazard LOOKS; it never changes the physics behind solar output or health. Turning a hazard off removes it from the simulation entirely.

s: 尚未模拟 — 仅跟踪风险概况
src: Not simulated yet — tracked for the risk profile only

s: 干燥地面在风速低于以下值时开始扬尘，除非干旱期间下过雨。轻微的薄雾刚过，真正的沙尘暴在约 30 mph，约 45 mph 时形成屏障。需要勾选上方的沙尘暴危害，并开启模拟。
src: Dry ground starts to blow once the wind passes the speed below, unless it rained within the dry spell. Light haze just past it, a real dust storm around 30 mph and a wall from about 45 mph. Needs the Dust Storm hazard ticked above and the simulation switched on.

s: 根据站点的年降雨量计算扬尘程度：沙漠地带（年降雨量低于 250 mm）为满值，湿润的绿色站点（年降雨量 1000 mm 及以上）为五分之一。
src: Scales the dust by the site's yearly rainfall: full on desert ground (under 250 mm a year), a fifth on a wet, green site (1000 mm and more).

s: 沙尘暴的视觉效果。这些不改变任何内容，仅改变图片：能见度、太阳能输出和健康状况仍遵循真实尘埃。下方预览沙尘暴以查看您的更改。

While the window view is open

s: 实时：模拟日期和时间跟随您的电脑时钟，比例为1×（外部太阳与真实时间匹配）。1×：来自模拟任意位置的实时时间。退出时两者恢复到之前的速度。

s: 如果进入视图时显示器变灰，请切换到无边框窗口。该显示器渲染正常，但拒绝呈现全屏窗口，这发生在它由与主游戏窗口不同的图形适配器驱动时。
src: If a monitor goes flat grey when you enter the view, switch this to Borderless window. That monitor is rendering fine but refusing to present a fullscreen window, which happens when it is driven by a different graphics adapter than the main game window.

s: 三个1080p显示器代表了世界的三个完整渲染（包括阴影）。在降低图形质量之前，请降低渲染比例——植被和道具细节跟随游戏窗口的相机，它们共享同一个视点。
src: Three 1080p monitors are three full renders of the world (plus shadows). Drop the render scale before dropping the graphics quality — vegetation and prop detail follow the game window's camera, which shares the same eye.

src: Set viewpoint from current player position

s: 您当前站立和面向的位置将成为此地图的公交车停靠点。

s: 先打开一个世界：视角就是玩家在该世界中的站立位置。
src: Open a world first: the viewpoint is where the player stands in it.

s: 在视图中：WASD / Q E 移动视点，← → 转向，用鼠标拖动转向，R 重置到保存点，Ctrl+S 保存，I 识别屏幕，U 切换 UI，Esc 或 F11 退出。
src: In the view: WASD / Q E nudge the eye, ← → turn, drag with the mouse to turn, R resets to the saved spot, Ctrl+S saves, I identifies screens, U toggles the UI, Esc or F11 leaves.

s: 先打开一个世界；F11 会打开视图。
src: Open a world first; F11 there opens the view.

s: 此地图未保存视角——视图将从玩家站立的位置打开。
src: No viewpoint saved for this map — the view will open where the player stands.

s: 默认关闭。开启后，F11 或下方按钮将跨越您的显示器阵列渲染世界。
src: Off by default. When on, F11 or the button below renders the world across your monitor row.

s: 将世界渲染到一排物理显示器上，使其看起来像公交车外的窗户：一个视点，每个显示器一个偏轴视锥体，直线在边框上保持直线。游戏窗口本身成为其中一个显示器；其他显示器则作为额外的全屏窗口打开。
src: Renders the world across a row of physical monitors so they read as windows out of the bus: ONE eye point, one off-axis frustum per monitor, straight lines stay straight across the bezels. The game window itself becomes one of the monitors; the others open as extra fullscreen windows.

s: 间隙是从边框到边框的距离。视距是从您的眼睛到显示器玻璃的直线距离。“座位视高”是您的眼睛相对于保存的视点地面点的高度。
src: Gap is bezel edge to bezel edge. Eye distance is from your eye to the monitor glass, straight ahead. 'Seat eye height' is how far your eye sits above the saved viewpoint's ground point.

s: 拖动设备可在页面上移动。点击一个运行点可放入保险丝、断路器、开关或公交车。数据线显示通信。滚轮缩放。
src: Drag a device to move it on the page. Click a run to put a fuse, breaker, switch or bus in it. Data leads shows comms. Wheel zooms.
Show VE.Direct, VE.Bus and other comms leads
